description: Prepare a PRIVATE sharing package of the current chart image, editable analysis and social caption. Only use when asked for something shareable. Returns a private review link, NOT a public link. The person must open it, edit/review and explicitly publish; you cannot publish or post on their behalf. Chart annotations are included. Do not include private account information.

body.description: Plain-text analysis: evidence, timeframe, venue, data timestamp, alternative scenario and invalidation. Only use verified tool results. Never include account balances, keys or private notes.

caption.description: Editable social caption in the user’s language, ideally under 220 characters for X. Invite discussion, not a trade. Do not add a URL; the review page adds the public link after approval.

indicators.description: Ids or common names ("ema50", "rsi", "bollinger"), or {studyId, params}.

levels.description: Prices to mark as horizontal lines, or {price, label, color}.

symbol.description: Optional: set the instrument in this call.

title.description: A specific, factual title. No return promises.

name: analysis_prepare
